header: Arguments for and against, in two columns
lead: One list of rows, sorted into two columns by a switch on each row. Moving an argument to the other side takes one click, not a cut and paste.

points.title: Moving an argument takes one click.
points.value: Flip the switch on the row

points.title: The markers are glyphs, not just colours.
points.value: A tick and a cross still read in black and white

points.title: Both sides share one list in the backend.
points.value: Long lists need care when sorting

points.title: There is no column for neutral points.
points.value: Use a Definition List for those
